description: Development, regulatory and commercial profile of the leading obesity drugs, researched from company press releases, FDA announcements, journal publications and trial registries up to 25 Oct 2026. Loaded into the drug pages by the daily sync; values typed on the website take priority over these. Dates written as 2026-Q4, 2026-H2 or 2027 are company guidance or registry estimates, not confirmed dates.

fields.api: Semaglutide (acylated GLP-1 receptor agonist peptide); oral tablets co-formulated with the absorption enhancer SNAC
fields.regulatory_status: Approved — US: Wegovy injection 2.4 mg (Jun 2021), Wegovy pill 25 mg (Dec 2025), Wegovy HD 7.2 mg (Mar 2026); also approved in the EU, Japan, China and other markets
fields.designations: Wegovy HD 7.2 mg: FDA Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (approved 54 days after filing)
fields.patents: Core compound patent: US 5 Dec 2032 (US 10,525,129); EU/UK about Mar 2031 with SPC; Japan about 2031. Expired or lapsed Mar 2026 in China, India, Brazil and Canada
fields.anticipated_launch: On the market (US 2021). Wegovy pill launched in the US Jan 2026. Generic entry from 2026 in China, India, Brazil and Canada; US/EU about 2031–2033
fields.efficacy_signal: STEP 1: −14.9% vs −2.4% at 68 wk (2.4 mg). STEP UP 7.2 mg: −20.7% at 72 wk (efficacy estimand). SELECT: 20% lower risk of major cardiovascular events
fields.safety_signal: GI events (nausea 44% vs 17% in STEP 1); AE discontinuation 7.0% vs 3.1%; boxed warning for thyroid C-cell tumours; altered skin sensation more common at 7.2 mg (FDA reviewing)

results.population: 1,961 adults with obesity or overweight, no diabetes
17,604 adults with cardiovascular disease and overweight/obesity, no diabetes
Adults with obesity, no diabetes
307 adults with obesity or overweight

source.label: Novo Nordisk: Wegovy pill FDA approval

results.result: Altered skin sensation (dysaesthesia) more common than at 2.4 mg; generally resolved; FDA investigating further

Compound patent expires or lapses — generic entry opens

fields.api: Tirzepatide (synthetic 39-amino-acid GIP/GLP-1 dual receptor agonist peptide with a C20 fatty diacid moiety), once weekly
fields.regulatory_status: Approved — US: Mounjaro (type 2 diabetes, May 2022), Zepbound (chronic weight management, Nov 2023; obstructive sleep apnoea, Dec 2024); approved in the EU and other markets
fields.patents: US compound patent US 9,474,780 expires 13 May 2036; autoinjector device patents expire 2031
fields.anticipated_launch: On the market (Zepbound US launch Dec 2023)
fields.efficacy_signal: SURMOUNT-1: −20.9% vs −3.1% at 72 wk (15 mg). SURMOUNT-5: −20.2% vs −13.7% for semaglutide 2.4 mg
fields.safety_signal: GI events (nausea up to 33%); AE discontinuation 4.3–7.1% vs 2.6% (SURMOUNT-1); boxed warning for thyroid C-cell tumours

results.population: 2,539 adults with obesity or overweight, no diabetes
751 adults with obesity, no diabetes

fields.api: Orforglipron (non-peptide small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist), once-daily tablet taken with or without food
fields.regulatory_status: Approved — US: Foundayo for chronic weight management (1 Apr 2026). Type 2 diabetes: US submission planned
fields.designations: FDA Commissioner's National Priority Voucher — first new molecular entity approved under the programme
fields.anticipated_launch: Launched in the US Apr 2026 (LillyDirect, retail and telehealth; $149/month self-pay at the lowest dose; Medicare Part D from 1 Jul 2026)
fields.efficacy_signal: ATTAIN-1: −12.4% vs −0.9% at 72 wk (36 mg, completers); −11.1% vs −2.1% (all participants)
fields.safety_signal: GI events (nausea, constipation, diarrhoea, vomiting, dyspepsia); boxed warning for thyroid C-cell tumours; ACHIEVE-4 showed no excess cardiovascular risk

sources.label: FDA: first NME under the National Priority Voucher programme

fields.api: Retatrutide (LY3437943), synthetic GIP/GLP-1/glucagon triple receptor agonist peptide, once weekly
fields.regulatory_status: Investigational — Phase 3 obesity trials positive (TRIUMPH-1, -2, -3); US submission planned Q1 2027
fields.anticipated_launch: US submission Q1 2027 (company); approval unlikely before late 2027–2028 (estimate based on a standard review)
fields.efficacy_signal: TRIUMPH-1: −28.3% vs −2.2% at 80 wk (12 mg, efficacy estimand); −30.3% at 104 wk in the BMI ≥35 extension
fields.safety_signal: Dose-dependent GI events (nausea up to 42%); dysaesthesia 5–12.5% vs 0.9%; AE discontinuation up to 11.3% (12 mg) vs 4.9%

results.population: 2,339 adults with obesity or overweight, no diabetes
532 participants with BMI ≥35
1,152 adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity or overweight
1,949 adults with BMI ≥35 and established cardiovascular disease

milestones.title: TRIUMPH-1: up to 28.3% weight loss at 80 weeks (30.3% at 104 weeks in the BMI ≥35 extension) sets a new bar for obesity drugs
TRIUMPH-2 (type 2 diabetes) and TRIUMPH-3 (severe obesity + CVD) positive
US submission (BLA) for obesity, after the manufacturing (CMC) package is complete

fields.api: Cagrilintide 2.4 mg (long-acting amylin analogue) + semaglutide 2.4 mg (GLP-1 receptor agonist), once-weekly single injection
fields.regulatory_status: Under FDA review — application submitted 18 Dec 2025; decision expected Q4 2026 (no public PDUFA date)
fields.anticipated_launch: US launch possible from late 2026 / early 2027 if approved (estimate)

fields.safety_signal: GI events (REDEFINE 1: nausea 55%, constipation 31%, vomiting 26%); AE discontinuation 5.9% vs 3.5%

fields.api: Survodutide (BI 456906), glucagon/GLP-1 dual receptor agonist peptide, once weekly
fields.regulatory_status: Investigational — Phase 3: obesity (SYNCHRONIZE-1 and -2 positive) and MASH (LIVERAGE, LIVERAGE-Cirrhosis ongoing)
fields.designations: FDA Fast Track (May 2021) and Breakthrough Therapy (Sep 2024, MASH F2–F3); EMA PRIME (Nov 2023); China NMPA Breakthrough Therapy (Jun 2024); Taiwan Breakthrough (Sep 2024)
fields.anticipated_launch: Not announced — submission timing not disclosed; SYNCHRONIZE-CVOT results expected later in 2026
fields.efficacy_signal: SYNCHRONIZE-1: −16.6% vs −3.2% at 76 wk (6.0 mg). SYNCHRONIZE-2 (T2D): −13.1% vs −3.1%; A1C −1.21 points
fields.safety_signal: GI events, mostly during dose escalation; GI-related discontinuation 18% vs 1.2% (SYNCHRONIZE-2)

results.population: 725 adults with obesity or overweight, no diabetes
755 adults with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes
results.result: Up to −13.1%; A1C up to −1.21 points
Mostly mild-to-moderate GI events; GI-related discontinuation 18%

fields.api: Maridebart cafraglutide (AMG 133): antibody–peptide conjugate — a GIP-receptor-antagonist monoclonal antibody linked to two GLP-1 agonist peptides; monthly or less frequent injection
fields.anticipated_launch: MARITIME-1 and -2 readouts expected 2027 (registry estimates); launch not before 2028 (estimate)
fields.efficacy_signal: Phase 2 (52 wk): −16.2% (obesity) and −12.3% (obesity + T2D) in all patients; about −20% / −17% in those who completed treatment; no plateau
fields.safety_signal: GI events, mainly with the first doses; vomiting frequent without dose escalation; GI discontinuation 12–27% with fixed doses vs up to 7.8% with escalation

results.population: Adults with obesity, with or without type 2 diabetes

results.result: GI discontinuation 12–27% with fixed doses, up to 7.8% with dose escalation; vomiting 43–92% depending on arm

fields.safety_signal: Mostly mild-to-moderate GI events, consistent with the GLP-1 class
